diagnosis: Each unit waits at its home post (spread by call volume); the closest idle unit is sent.

Idle units sit stacked at downtown posts (M502-M508 at post 2, M509-M514 at post 0) while the outer west and south posts are empty or served by a single unit. The new policy re-spreads the on-shift units each hour with a demand-weighted coverage plan that favours the slow neighborhoods' posts. It keeps units concentrated where call volume is high, and for calls outside the slow areas it slightly prefers units not posted in them.
